name: Dervish Sash
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 15th; Slot chest; Price 35,350 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

These flowing sashes are often golden or vibrant blue, and made of the richest silks.

If the wearer of a dervish sash has the nimble class feature, the dodge bonus granted by it increases by 1.

In addition, if the wearer of a dervish sash has either the Whirling Dervish feat or 10 ranks in Perform (dance), he can cast dance of a hundred cuts once per day as a swift action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells dance of a hundred cuts, haste; Cost 17,675 gp
